title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: No-purchase ONU activities, resources, and recurring community events with direct university evidence of free access.

cards.title: Catch a Student Planning Committee event
cards.subtitle: Campus-wide weekly entertainment
cards.notes: Check ONU announcements for the Student Planning Committee’s weekly entertainment, then go with friends; ONU says its programming is always free for students.
cards.short_summary: A recurring, student-focused free entertainment option.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU states that the Student Planning Committee puts on free entertainment each week for all students.
cards.access_notes: For ONU students; check campus announcements for the specific event, date, and location.

cards.title: Attend the ONU Oratory & Art Festival
cards.subtitle: Bear Cave and McIntosh Center — October 24, 2026
cards.notes: Register as a supporter or attend with an invited participant to see student speech, performance, and visual art at this stated free campus festival.
cards.short_summary: A one-day student-expression festival with art and performance.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU lists the October 24, 2026 Oratory & Art Festival at Bear Cave and McIntosh Center as free, with food and beverages provided.
cards.access_notes: The 2026 listing identifies high-school students and educators as participants; supporters are encouraged to register to attend.

cards.title: Bring a blanket to Patriotic Pops
cards.subtitle: Sculpture Mall east of McIntosh Center
cards.notes: When the every-other-July concert returns, bring lawn chairs or a blanket and meet friends on the sculpture mall for the outdoor Lima Symphony performance.
cards.short_summary: A recurring outdoor campus concert presented without admission.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU says its every-other-July Patriotic Pops concert with the Lima Symphony Orchestra is a free public concert on campus.
cards.access_notes: Recurring every other July; ONU directs attendees to the sculpture mall east of McIntosh Center and advises bringing chairs or blankets.

cards.title: Browse a DigitalCommons@ONU rabbit hole
cards.subtitle: Online repository from ONU Libraries
cards.notes: Open a collection together, pick a campus-created paper, image, or publication, and compare what you find; the repository is available without a purchase.
cards.short_summary: A free online window into ONU scholarship and creative work.
cards.evidence_claim: DigitalCommons@ONU provides free and open access to scholarship and creative works from ONU faculty, students, staff, and units.
cards.source_title: DigitalCommons@ONU - Ohio Northern University Digital Repository
cards.access_notes: Online access; no campus entry or ONU login is stated as required for browsing the open repository.

cards.title: Make a study meetup at ONU Tutoring
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Heterick Memorial Library
cards.notes: Bring a classmate to a drop-in session or book an appointment; the program covers many undergraduate courses and can help locate support when needed.
cards.short_summary: Free academic help that can turn a tough assignment into a shared work session.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU offers free weekly drop-in and by-appointment tutoring for many undergraduate courses.
cards.access_notes: For ONU students; tutoring is located on the second floor of Heterick Memorial Library. Contact tutoring@onu.edu for availability.

cards.title: Use the Career Closet together
cards.subtitle: Center for Student Success, Heterick Memorial Library
cards.notes: Coordinate a visit with the Polar Career Center if you need interview or event clothing, then help a friend choose pieces suited to their upcoming occasion.
cards.short_summary: A donated-clothing resource for ONU students preparing for professional events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Polar Career Center says its Career Closet resource is offered free of charge to ONU students.
cards.source_title: Polar Career Center | Ohio Northern University
cards.access_notes: For ONU students; arrange a time with Polar Career Center staff. The office is on Heterick Memorial Library’s second floor.

cards.title: Build a Handshake profile side by side
cards.subtitle: Online career-exploration activity
cards.notes: Use your ONU email to create an account with a friend, fill in interests, and browse the platform’s job, internship, employer, and virtual-event options.
cards.short_summary: A free online career platform for ONU students.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU’s Polar Careers page instructs students to create a free Handshake account using their .edu email address.
cards.source_title: Career Exploration and Resources | Ohio Northern University
cards.access_notes: Requires an ONU .edu email address to create the free account.

cards.entity_name: ONU Volunteer Income Tax Assistance Program
cards.title: Book free VITA tax-prep help
cards.subtitle: Dicke College of Business Administration
cards.notes: If you meet the income guideline, ask about ONU’s VITA service and bring required tax documents; business students prepare returns for Ada residents and fellow students.
cards.short_summary: Free tax-return preparation for eligible local residents and students.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU describes its VITA program as providing free tax-return preparation for individuals and families making about $70,000 or less annually.
cards.source_title: Justin Zollars: VITA volunteer | Ohio Northern University
cards.access_notes: Eligibility is income-limited; confirm seasonal appointment details and required documents with the Dicke College of Business Administration.

cards.title: Use the free walk-in health clinic
cards.subtitle: Available to all ONU students
cards.notes: If you need non-emergency care, use the walk-in clinic for an assessment, treatment, or referral; consider inviting a trusted friend to accompany you if appropriate.
cards.short_summary: A student-accessible walk-in clinic for general health support.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU states that it has a free walk-in health clinic available to all students for general assessments, treatments, and referrals.
cards.access_notes: For ONU students; this is a health service rather than a social venue. Use emergency services for emergencies.

cards.title: Do a no-charge laundry reset
cards.subtitle: Residence-hall common areas
cards.notes: Use your residence hall’s common-area machines during a planned reset with roommates; bring your own supplies and follow your building’s shared-space expectations.
cards.short_summary: A practical, no-charge shared facility for residential students.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU states that residence-hall common areas include high-efficiency laundry machines with no charge for use.
cards.access_notes: For ONU residence-hall students and their assigned building’s common areas; laundry supplies are not stated as provided.

warnings: Some options are student-only or event-specific; review the cited source and current campus communications before going.
